title: Standard BioTools Dynamic Array 48.48: Load 4 uL
author: Standard BioTools

steps.title: Prepare samples, assays, and IFC
steps.instruction: Follow the Standard BioTools X9 User Guide (e.g., Gene Expression Using the 48.48 IFC‑X with TaqMan Assays) to set up the sample and assay plates and the 48.48 IFC before running the OT‑2.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 6 µL of each sample into 48 wells of a 96‑well plate.
Transfer 6 µL of each assay into 48 wells of a separate 96‑well plate.
Ensure every well (blue‑highlighted in the guide) contains liquid.
Centrifuge both the sample and assay plates briefly to bring liquids to the bottom of the wells.
Add control line fluid to the IFC accumulators as specified by the selected workflow (red‑arrow locations in the guide).
Remove the protective film from the bottom of the 48.48 IFC.

steps.title: Transfer assays to left side
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2, dispense 4 µL of each assay from the assay plate into the corresponding left‑side wells of the 48.48 IFC.

steps.title: Transfer samples to right side
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2, dispense 4 µL of each sample from the sample plate into the corresponding right‑side wells of the 48.48 IFC.
